newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-PEMBRIDGE WINS FITNESS BATTLE TO FACE DUTCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PEMBRIDGE WINS FITNESS BATTLE TO FACE DUTCH.

text.p: Midfielder Mark Pembridge won his fitness battle and will play for Wales in their World Cup qualifier against the Netherlands on Saturday night.

The Sheffield Wednesday player was a doubtful starter because of a calf strain but he was able to train with the Welsh squad for the first time on Thursday and came through another session on Friday to secure his place.
Welsh boss Bobby Gould, announced his team on Thursday, naming Pembridge in the side.
Wales team: Neville Southall; Mark Bowen, Andy Melville, Kit Symons, Mark Pembridge, John Robinson, Marcus Browning, Barry Horne, Gary Speed, Mark Hughes, Dean Saunders.
